onboarding.welcome: Ma'am Lorna: “Maayong buntag! Welcome to Window 3. Start by pressing S (or dragging the Student ID onto the reader) to open ISMIS.”
onboarding.after_scan_clean: Ma'am Lorna: “Compare the paper checklist with the ISMIS Record tab. Every item is Attached and matches—press 1 (Approve), then Space to hand the papers back.”
onboarding.missing_intro: Ma'am Lorna: “Next student. Remember our goal: 90% accuracy, 90% of the line served, and zero walkouts for 3 stars. Scan their ID (S) and check carefully.”
onboarding.missing_after_scan: Ma'am Lorna: “Look at Library clearance: 'Missing' on the paper, 'Required' in ISMIS. Click Library clearance on both sides to flag the mismatch. (Real flags boost patience; false alarms cost patience!)”
onboarding.missing_after_flag: Ma'am Lorna: “Good catch! You can press A to ask the student about a flag, or press 5 (Turn away) › Missing requirement, tick Library clearance, and press Space.”
onboarding.missing_after_ask: Ma'am Lorna: “They admitted they forgot it. Now press 5 (Turn away) › Missing requirement, tick Library clearance, and press Space. Wrong calls bring students back angry—twice and they walk out!”
onboarding.triage_intro: Ma'am Lorna: “See the PWD badge in the line above? Click a priority student's face (PWD or GRAD) in the line strip to call them to the front, and watch the live office statuses on the right.”
onboarding.solo_practice: Ma'am Lorna: “Ikaw na bahala sa nahabilin sa pila. Press Tab anytime for the SA Handbook—I'll be watching your stamps!”

2.title: Today's office bulletin
2.announcement: Registrar notice: Graduating seniors have priority today. Watch for impatient seniors in the queue—they drain the line's patience twice as fast.
2.policy: All four clearance attachments (Library, Exit survey, Graduation fee, Photo) must be verified against ISMIS before stamping. Prep week is over: from today, a wrong call costs the line much more patience.
2.event_preview: Expected today: Heavy mid-morning senior turnout and OAS scholarship clearance verification.

3.title: Today's office bulletin
3.announcement: Department notice: Major 3rd-year block sections are filling up across all windows. Use the Section Picker (2 Fix) to reassign full sections.
3.policy: Official abbreviations on IDs (Ma. for Maria, J. for Juan, BS IT for BSIT) are valid—do not flag them as mismatches.
3.event_preview: Expected today: Students arriving without ID cards (search by ID number) and section bottlenecks.

4.title: Today's office bulletin
4.announcement: Cashier advisory: Window queues at the Accounting & Cashier's Office will back up starting at 10:00 AM (+20 min trip time).
4.policy: Any unpaid balance in ISMIS must be routed to the Cashier (3 Route) before enrollment can be approved. Random spot checks begin today.
4.event_preview: Expected today: Parents accompanying sophomores, VIP favor requests, and a long Cashier line after 10:00 AM.

5.title: Today's office bulletin
5.schedule: 8:00 AM–12:00 PM · 1st-year freshman enrollment & ISMIS activation.
5.announcement: ITO advisory: High volume of locked freshman accounts. Verify the birthday on the Admission Slip before printing a temporary password.
5.policy: Multiple issues? Handle in strict tier order: 1. Turn away › 2. Route to office › 3. Fix at the window.
5.event_preview: Expected today: Confused freshmen at the wrong window, thermal printer hiccups, and relatives trying to claim accounts.

6.title: Today's office bulletin
6.schedule: 8:00 AM–12:00 PM · Open Market (all year levels, live slot drain).
6.announcement: All registrar windows are enrolling simultaneously—open section seats will drain in real time while the Section Picker is open.
6.policy: Check the Grades tab for prerequisites: 5.0 is rejected (5 Turn away); INC is routed to Consultation (3 Route).
6.event_preview: Expected today: Rush waves at 9:00 AM and 10:30 AM, plus brief campus ISMIS network lag.

7.title: Today's office bulletin
7.announcement: Departmental advisers will be on break from 10:30 AM to 11:00 AM. Use the Hold bench (4 Hold, 3 seats max) while Consultation is on break.
7.policy: Adding a subject requires an authentic adviser signature matching the Advisers tab specimen. Forged signatures are rejected immediately.
7.event_preview: Expected today: Adviser break at 10:30 AM, forged consultation slips, and scholarship interview rush.

8.title: Today's office bulletin
8.schedule: 8:00 AM–12:00 PM · Adjustment Period, Day 2 (Overloads & Final Changes).
8.announcement: The Dean's Office is open for overload approvals until 11:30 AM only. After 11:30 AM, it closes for the day.
8.policy: Loads exceeding 24 units must be routed to the Dean's Office while open, or turned away ('Office closed today') once shut.
8.event_preview: Expected today: Final-day overload cramming and Dean's Office cutoff at 11:30 AM.

2.flash: ANNOUNCEMENT · Ma'am Lorna: Watch for missing graduation photos on senior checklists!
2.banner: Ma'am Lorna: “Daghang graduating nga nakalimot sa graduation photo ug library clearance. Check every line.”

2.flash: OAS NOTICE · Scholarship exit interviews starting at the Guidance Center
2.banner: Office Announcement: Graduating scholars are rushing to finish clearance before their 10:30 AM exit interviews.

3.flash: WINDOW 1 · Kuya Jun: “Puno na ang morning sections sa IT ug Accounting!”
3.banner: Coworker Kuya Jun (Window 1): “Morning sections are filling up fast! Check the Schedule tab before approving.”

3.flash: GUARDHOUSE NOTICE · Several 3rd-years left their IDs at the gate; use ID number search
3.banner: Guardhouse Notice: Students without ID cards will state their 8-digit ID number—type it into the ISMIS search box.

4.flash: MA'AM LORNA · “Heads up: someone claiming to be the Dean's nephew is in the building.”
4.banner: Ma'am Lorna: “Kon naay mangayo og pabor o moingon nga kaila sa Dean, ayaw kahadlok. Follow the rules—I check the logs.”

4.flash: CASHIER ALERT · Long line at the Cashier's Office! Trips now take longer
4.banner: Office Update: The Cashier queue has backed up down the hallway. Routed students will take longer to return.

5.flash: CAMPUS EVENT · Freshman orientation just let out—expect lost 1st-years at Window 3!
5.banner: Ate Bea (Window 2): “Freshman orientation just finished! Half of them think we issue PE uniforms—just check their papers.”

5.flash: EQUIPMENT · Window 3 thermal slip printer sputtered—roller cleared!
5.banner: Printer Notice: The thermal password printer hiccupped on a curled roll, but Kuya Jun tapped it back into alignment.

6.flash: ISMIS ADVISORY · Heavy campus traffic causing brief server hiccups across windows
6.banner: ITO Network Advisory: All four year levels are logged into ISMIS at once. Expect seats to drain rapidly while picking sections!

6.flash: REGISTRAR MEMO · Strict audit on prerequisite grades (5.0 vs INC) during Open Market
6.banner: Ma'am Lorna: “Ayaw kalimti ang Grades tab! A 5.0 in the prerequisite is a hard reject; an INC goes to Consultation.”

7.flash: SCHOLARSHIP RUSH · Scholars need 18+ units validated before their interview!
7.banner: OAS Advisory: Scholarship interviewees are lining up to add subjects—verify their adviser signatures against the specimen sheet.

7.flash: CONSULTATION NOTICE · Advisers go on coffee break at 10:30 AM—get the Hold bench ready!
7.banner: Ma'am Lorna: “Consultation closes for break at 10:30 AM. Don't send students to an empty room—use 4 (Hold) to park them on the bench!”

8.flash: DEAN'S OFFICE · Overload petitions (>24 units) accepted only until 11:30 AM today!
8.banner: Dean's Office Notice: Any student exceeding 24 units after adding a subject must be routed to the Dean before 11:30 AM.

8.flash: LAST CALL · Dean's Office closes in 5 minutes (11:30 AM)!
8.banner: Ma'am Lorna: “Hapita na mag-11:30! Once the Dean's Office closes for the day, turn overload students away to come back tomorrow.”
